about.meta.title: About Artifact Share | Artifact Share
about.meta.description: A service for sharing HTML files safely within your company.
about.hero.title: About Artifact Share
about.hero.intro: It is for teams that use AI to create HTML or Markdown and share it with colleagues and project collaborators. It helps them show work safely, collect reactions, and keep it updated. If you arrived here from a shared page, the file you saw was posted to Artifact Share.
about.flow.title: How a draft becomes something your team can decide on
about.flow.intro: Through publishing, commenting, and updating, what's on the shared page grows into something your team can review and decide on.
about.flow.steps.publish.title: Publish and choose who can view
about.flow.steps.publish.body: Publish a file from AI or your browser, then choose who can view it — everyone at your company, project members only, or specific people. Only the people you choose can open it.
about.flow.steps.comment.title: Comment at the relevant place
about.flow.steps.comment.body: Anyone viewing the shared page can comment directly at the relevant place in the file. The person who posted it can then apply those comments to the next version.
about.flow.steps.update.title: Update to the next version at the same URL
about.flow.steps.update.body: When you update, everyone viewing the shared page sees the new content at the same URL. Viewers never need to look for a new link.
about.audience.title: Where it's used
about.audience.body: It's used to show AI-drafted research findings, KPI summaries, or design proposals to the people who need to review them. Comments on the shared page help turn the draft into something ready for a decision.
about.ai.title: Using with AI
about.ai.body: You can publish and update to the next version directly from the AI you already use, not only from your browser. The guide below covers how to get started with the CLI or MCP.
about.ai.cta: See how to publish from your AI
about.closing: If Artifact Share fits how you work, you can start for free.
about.official.title: Official information
about.official.audience: Teams that create HTML or Markdown with AI and need to share, review, and update it with colleagues, clients, or project collaborators
about.official.formats: HTML, Markdown, folders, and static sites
about.official.sharing: Who can view, updates to the next version at the same URL, and comments
about.official.ai: CLI for Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor Agent; remote MCP for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor chat, and Claude Cowork
about.official.plans: Free, Plus, and Team, with no additional fees based on the number of publishers, viewers, or commenters
about.official.note: This page describes Artifact Share at artifactshare.com, operated by TechTalk, Inc.

lp.works.mcp.body: Connect the MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor chat, and share what you make mid-conversation.
lp.works.chatgpt.title: Add to ChatGPT
lp.quote.text: “Free, no user limits — we just started. Before we knew it every share on the team was a URL, and nobody asks ‘which one is latest?’ anymore.”
lp.quote.attr: Engineering manager, product development team at an e-commerce company
lp.trust.c1.title: Never leaves by default
lp.trust.c1.body: Fresh posts are visible only to your workspace. Safe with zero configuration.
lp.trust.c2.title: Choose who sees it outside
lp.trust.c2.body: For clients: expiring links and one-time email codes, only for who needs it.
lp.trust.c3.title: Flat price, unlimited users
lp.trust.c3.body: The price never changes with headcount. A tool like this only works when everyone has it.
lp.ctaEnd.body: No credit card. Start from the browser, CLI, or MCP.
lp.ctaEnd.free: The Free plan is free up to 100MB, unlimited users.
